regime_context: Detector shows a narrowing leadership structure (6 of 16 themes eligible, one_narrative=false, rotation.directional=false) with Oil & Gas Producers as the lone strong leader (score 1.655, durability 0.73, full breadth) far above Big Banks (0.635). The validated trend-gate is active (gate_helps=true), so eligible themes have an absolute-trend discipline working for them; momentum rank itself is not a return forecast. Macro backdrop is coincident and dominated by AI/tech and geopolitics headlines, but that is market-level context only.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Big Banks' breadth (currently 0.429) expands above 0.6 while maintaining hurst_tag 'trend' and eligible=true — that combination would retire the 'thin leadership' caution and mark a genuine challenger to Oil & Gas, rather than just a rank-2 attention artifact.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The lone dominant theme with full breadth (1.0), top rank, and a high durability_bar (0.73) while being trend-gate eligible — the only leg the backtest validates as risk control is active here. Crowding (z=1.3, crowded=true) is elevated, which caps the size-down case rather than supporting aggression, but the trend-gate eligibility plus breadth argue for retaining exposure over a fade. Lean is a directional maintain rather than a fresh chase.
theses.dissent: Crowding at z=1.3 with hurst_tag 'mixed' (not clean trend) means this leadership is reflexively extended; rank-IC ~0 gives no forward edge, so a mean-reversion shakeout in energy could hit hardest precisely because it is the most owned theme.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO breaks below its own 20-day average while the S&P/TSX stays flat or up

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Trend-gate eligible with hurst_tag 'trend' (cleanest trend-health label among the top ranks), durability 0.61, and non-crowded (z=0.35). This is the most coherent relative-strength candidate after Oil & Gas, and the only other theme with a durable trend profile within the narrowing eligible set. Low conviction because breadth (0.429) is thin and momentum rank is an attention lens, not alpha.
theses.dissent: Thin breadth (0.429) means leadership is carried by a handful of names; if the macro rate backdrop turns, Canadian banks' rate sensitivity can reverse quickly and the 'trend' tag offers no directional forecast.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO trades below its 50-day average for five consecutive sessions

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Clearly ineligible (eligible=false) with durability_bar 0.16, breadth 0.0, and hurst_tag 'mixed' — the absolute-trend gate that is the one validated risk-control leg is NOT active here. Lean is to avoid new exposure until trend health returns, not a short or fade.
theses.dissent: Gold miners have reflexive safe-haven flows that can ignite on a geopolitical headline; the gate being off is a risk-discipline signal, not a statement that upside is impossible.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO closes above its 50-day average on rising breadth (breadth moves off 0.0) and the gate flips eligible
